ns2:course.label: Crip* Graduate Directed Research
ns2:course.description: Directed research project or creative project in the area of Cripistemology and the Arts. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of eight (8) hours. Prerequisite: Instructor approval required. Restricted to graduate students in good standing.
